reportDescription: Read directly from this browser. Everything stays on your device.
identityDescription: Original values reported by the selected WebGL context.
privacyDescription: The optional renderer extension is unavailable. Privacy settings or the browser may limit these details; WebGL can still work.
softwareDescription: This renderer name indicates CPU-based graphics. It does not identify a physical graphics card.
unavailableDescription: This browser could not create the context. Browser settings, graphics drivers, device support, or resource limits may be responsible. You can refresh to try again.
limitsDescription: Limits exposed to web content, not a performance score or a measure of video memory.
attributesDescription: The actual settings of the context created for this report.
precisionDescription: Precision and exponent ranges reported for each shader stage and numeric format.
extensionsDescription: Search the extension names reported by this context.
aboutTitle: What this report can tell you
aboutDescription: WebGL shows the renderer selected by this browser. A device with multiple GPUs may use only one of them, and privacy settings can hide or generalize its name. This is not a complete list of installed graphics cards.
monitoringDescription: WebGL does not expose total video memory, GPU temperature, or live GPU utilization. Texture limits describe graphics capabilities, not memory capacity.
